If you’d prefer to keep the key private, just paste it into the placeholder below and I’ll fill in the rest:

```bash
API_KEY="YOUR_KEY_HERE"
IP="22.242.75.136"
VOTE_JSON='{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'

curl -X POST "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/$IP/votes" \
     -H "x-apikey: $API_KEY" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d "$VOTE_JSON"
```

That command will send the “malicious” verdict for the specified IP. Let me know if you’d like a Python example instead, or if you have any other questions!
